item.title: Poppy – “Guardian”
item.description: Poppy has released the new song “Guardian.” Today, hard-rock powerhouse and subversive performance artist Poppy gives listeners a larger glimpse into her upcoming album with a new single, “Guardian.” Poppy’s highly-awaited upcoming record, Empty Hands, is out on January 23 via Sumerian Records. “Guardian” is the latest in a series of singles that establish Poppy as an absolute force in the […]
